;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[June 2020 Afghanistan attacks]]
***At least 23 civilians are killed when rockets hit a [[cattle market]] in [[Sangin District|Sangin]], [[Helmand Province|Helmand]]. The [[Politics of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan|government]] and the [[Taliban]] blame each other for the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-blast-taliban/blast-kills-23-afghans-at-a-cattle-market-in-southern-afghanistan-idUSKBN2401BN (Reuters)]
*[[2020 Pakistan Stock Exchange attack]]
**An attack on the [[Pakistan Stock Exchange]] building in [[Karachi]] leaves at least seven people dead. The [[Balochistan Liberation Army]] (BLA) claims responsibility. However, the BLA's claim could not be independently verified. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-attacks/seven-die-as-separatist-gunmen-attack-pakistan-stock-exchange-idUSKBN2400IS (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the arts and cultural heritage]]
**[[Cirque du Soleil]] files for bankruptcy in Canada and cuts 3,500 jobs. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/06/29/business/cirque-du-soleil-bankruptcy/index.html (CNN)]

;Disasters and accidents
*At least 32 people die when their ferry collides with another vessel and sinks in the [[Buriganga River]], near [[Bangladesh]]'s capital [[Dhaka]]. There are still about 20 passengers missing. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-53190206 (BBC News)]

;International relations
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**[[Iran]] issues an arrest warrant against [[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and asks [[Interpol]] for help. [[Tehran]] prosecutor Ali Alqasimehr accuses Trump and 30 others of "murder and terrorism charges" for the [[assassination of Qasem Soleimani|killing of]] [[Qasem Soleimani]] in January. Interpol refuses the request. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/06/iran-issues-arrest-warrant-trump-asks-interpol-200629104710662.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Censorship in India]], [[China–India relations]]
**The [[Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology|Indian Ministry of Information Technology]] blocks 59 [[China|Chinese]] apps, including [[Online video platform|video sharing]] app [[TikTok]], citing security and privacy concerns. The bans come as tensions mount between the two countries over the [[2020 China–India skirmishes|recent border skirmishes]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/centre-bans-59-mobile-apps-including-tik-tok-uc-browser-others/articleshow/76694828.cms (''Times of India'')]
*[[China–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] formally revokes [[Hong Kong]]'s special trade status; it is now seen as equivalent to mainland China. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-hongkong-china-exports/u-s-ends-defense-exports-to-hong-kong-looking-to-more-restrictions-idUSKBN2402VY?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Fillon affair]]
**Former [[Prime Minister of France]] [[François Fillon]] and his wife [[Penelope Fillon|Penelope]] are found guilty in a fake jobs case, in which Penelope was paid [[Euro|€]]1.156 million for work she did not do as a parliamentary aide. François is sentenced to five years in prison, three of them [[Suspended sentence|suspended]], and is barred from office for ten years; Penelope will also serve a three year suspended sentence. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-53217298 (BBC News)]
*[[Joseph James DeAngelo|Golden State Killer]]
**[[Joseph James DeAngelo]] pleads guilty to all of the charges pressed against him, including 13 counts of first-degree murder. [https://www.sacbee.com/news/local/article243868517.html (''The Sacramento Bee'')]

;Science and technology
*[[Social media use by Donald Trump]]
**[[Reddit]] bans approximately 2,000 communities for violating its rules on hate speech, including [[r/The_Donald|The_Donald]], which was dedicated to [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and his supporters. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/06/29/technology/reddit-hate-speech.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[Twitch (service)|Twitch]] suspends U.S. President Donald Trump's account due to "hateful conduct" from two videos from 2015 and 2016 in which he made comments about Mexicans, which were found to be offensive and in breach of their community guidelines. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/06/29/technology/twitch-trump-suspension-hateful-conduct.html (''The New York Times'')]
